messages:
Grace (People Ops): Hey team — quick all-hands reminder for Wednesday 10:00am PT. Agenda draft below, pls drop questions here or submit anonymously via the form: https://forms.gle/RedwoodAllHandsQNA :wave:

- Exec update (Sam) — 5m
- Product/roadmap highlights (Theo) — 10m
- Dedicated beta & rollout plan (Maya) — 10m
- Policy update: data retention & log access (Luis) — 7m
- Customer wins & GTM highlights (Jules) — 3m
- Live Q&A / AMA — 15m

Please add any questions by Tue 3:00pm PT so we can prioritize. If you want a slide, ping me the deck by Tue EOD. :calendar: :speech_balloon:

Theo (Product): Quick ask — can we squeeze a 5m demo of the new rollout UI right after roadmap? small screen share.

Grace (People Ops): Yes — adding a 5m demo slot after roadmap. Thanks!

Maya (Eng): Can we add a short ops note about incident postmortem expectations? I think 2 mins to reiterate the checklist would help.

Grace (People Ops): Good call — adding a 2m ops reminder after the Dedicated beta update.

Jules (Sales): Can we include a single slide with top customer momentum bullets? 2 mins. I can drop it in #all-hands-slides.

Grace (People Ops): Added. If anyone wants to be specifically called on for Qs, mention here.

Sam (CEO): I'll do a 5m strategic framing and call out priorities for the next quarter. If you have 1-2 minute success stories, DM me.

Luis (Finance): Heads up — I'll be covering one policy change: default retention for debug logs and token traces will move to 30 days for hosted accounts, with enterprise opt-ins for longer retention. Will include compliance rationale and rollout timeline.

Grace (People Ops): Awesome, thanks Luis. Last call for questions — drop them here or in the form by Tue 3pm. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

--- (meeting happens) ---

all-hands-bot: Recording & notes posted: https://redwood.internal/recordings/all-hands-1769501234 (recording available to RedTeam).

all-hands-bot: Meeting summary (auto):
- Exec: Sam framed our focus on "serving-first" reliability and multi-environment parity.
- Product: Theo demoed the new rollout UI and the roadmap for v.next (canary + A/B support).
- Eng: Maya outlined Dedicated beta timeline — limited beta starts Apr 20; open beta in June.
- Policy: Luis summarized data retention change — default 30d for hosted debug logs; enterprise customers can request 90d+ with DPA addendum. Rollout begins May 1 with audit log exports available.
- Sales: Jules called out three reference customers ready for case studies.
- Ops note: Postmortem checklist and SLO reminder — please attach the incident template to any postmortem and assign a follow-up owner.

Takeaways / action items:
- Maya -> finish Dedicated beta infra prep by Apr 10.
- Theo -> share rollout UI quickstart in #devex by Apr 2.
- Luis -> publish the data retention FAQ + timeline by Apr 1.
- Jules -> submit customer case study drafts by Apr 15.
- Grace -> finalize all-hands slides and archive recording.

Maya (Eng): Thanks — noted owners. I'll post infra checklist tomorrow.

Theo (Product): Will drop the quickstart + demo clip in #devex after tidy-up.

Sam (CEO): Appreciate the concise agenda + great questions. Short, actionable all-hands today.

Grace (People Ops): Thanks everyone. If you couldn't make it, recording + notes are above. If you asked a Q in the form and didn't see it, DM me and I'll follow up. :thumbsup:
